summary.business_type: Ecommerce specialty coffee and instant-premix brand with local Bengaluru operations
top_findings: Production host, staging indexation, and legacy redirect strategy are unresolved
The shop catalog bails to client rendering and exposes zero raw product anchors
Sitemap, robots, canonicals, and utility-route noindex controls are missing
All sampled pages lack structured data
Product content and ecommerce policy coverage are too thin for a safe launch
quick_wins: Apply noindex to preview and operational routes
Set the production metadataBase and canonicals
Generate robots and sitemap after the host decision
Replace the oversized hero poster and remove duplicate preload
limitations: No Search Console, GA4, Merchant Center, GBP, or platform-specific AI visibility data
No CrUX field data and PageSpeed Insights was quota-blocked
Live deployment differs from the local workspace

findings.title: Canonical host and migration strategy unresolved
findings.description: The existing production domain remains indexed while the preview host has no canonical strategy.
findings.recommendation: Keep previews noindex and use the final production domain consistently with a complete redirect map.

findings.title: Shop catalog missing from raw HTML
findings.description: Twenty-three products are serialized but no product anchors are in initial HTML.
findings.recommendation: Server-render the default catalog and enhance it client-side.

findings.title: Discovery and index controls missing
findings.description: robots.txt and sitemap.xml return 404; canonicals and utility-route noindex are absent.
findings.recommendation: Add host-aware metadata routes, canonicals, and noindex controls.

findings.title: Live deployment differs from source
findings.description: Live image/logo behavior does not match the current repo and the current source build fails.
findings.recommendation: Get the build green, deploy the intended SHA, and re-audit.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Visible address, phone, email, and hours

findings.title: Product content is thin
findings.description: Sampled products expose roughly 51-75 main-content words and omit common purchase facts.
findings.recommendation: Add verified specifications, preparation, origin, storage, logistics, policies, reviews, and related products.

findings.title: Ecommerce policies are absent
findings.description: No privacy, terms, shipping, return/refund, or payment policy routes are present.
findings.recommendation: Publish accurate policies and link them from footer and purchase flows.

findings.title: Authority and claim evidence is limited
findings.description: Founder credentials, producer proof, certifications, review provenance, and health-claim evidence are weak.
findings.recommendation: Add accountable people and primary evidence; soften unsupported claims.

findings.title: Shop has no raw product-link graph
findings.description: The principal category page renders a skeleton without JavaScript.
findings.recommendation: Server-render product cards and links.

findings.title: Metadata templates are incomplete
findings.description: Short titles/descriptions, inherited Contact description, and no social metadata were found.
findings.recommendation: Add page-type metadata, canonicals, and OG/Twitter previews.

findings.title: Category parameters need a strategy
findings.description: Footer category links are query-string client states rather than dedicated landing pages.
findings.recommendation: Canonicalize filters to shop or build unique server-rendered category routes when justified.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Visible page data can support truthful JSON-LD

findings.title: Product and Offer markup absent
findings.description: Sampled product pages contain no structured data.
findings.recommendation: Add Product/Offer or ProductGroup and BreadcrumbList after canonical/product data is stable.

findings.title: Organization and WebSite graph absent
findings.description: No stable machine-readable brand entity exists.
findings.recommendation: Add linked Organization/WebSite JSON-LD with verified identity data.

findings.title: Oversized hero poster
findings.description: The likely LCP poster is about 976 KB and bypasses responsive image optimization.
findings.recommendation: Use one responsive, purpose-sized poster and verify LCP.

findings.title: Automatic 14.2 MB hero video
findings.description: Video begins downloading after load for every capable visitor.
findings.recommendation: Re-encode, adapt by device/preferences, and conditionally load.

findings.title: Material hydration footprint
findings.description: About 717.6 KB decoded JS/CSS and client-rendered catalog increase runtime cost.
findings.recommendation: Reduce client boundaries and server-render primary content.

findings.title: Product pages lack citable answer material
findings.description: Important specifications, preparation, evidence, and policies are absent.
findings.recommendation: Publish factual answer sections and evidence-led guides.

findings.title: Entity graph absent
findings.description: No Organization/Product graph exists.
findings.recommendation: Implement truthful schema as normal SEO infrastructure, not an AI hack.

findings.title: Hero poster bypasses responsive optimization
findings.description: The direct poster is about 976 KB.
findings.recommendation: Replace with a purpose-sized responsive poster.

findings.title: Product gallery alts are mechanical
findings.description: Images use generic Image N/thumbnail N descriptions.
findings.recommendation: Store asset-specific alt/caption data.

findings.title: Source assets are oversized
findings.description: Nineteen image files exceed 500 KB and 11 exceed 1 MB.
findings.recommendation: Normalize web masters and audit direct/CSS image use.

phases.name: Phase 1: Launch Blockers
items: Add canonicals, robots, sitemap, noindex, and schema

phases.name: Phase 3: Authority and Demand
items: Add verified reviews and Merchant Center

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring
items: Measure non-brand visibility and organic conversion
